title: QUIZ - 76
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Determine whether a given function formula is linear
questions.question: Is \( h(x) = 9x + 7 \) a linear function?

options.label: A
options.text: It is linear only for positive inputs.

options.label: B
options.text: It cannot be determined without a graph.

options.label: C
options.text: Yes, it is linear.

options.label: D
options.text: No, it is not linear.

questions.explanation: Every linear function has the form f(x) = ax + b, with the variable raised only to the first power. This matches that form.
questions.hint: A linear function must have the form f(x) = ax + b, with x appearing only to the first power.

questions.learningObjective: Recall the defining graphical feature of a linear function
questions.question: What graphical feature is characteristic of every linear function?

options.label: A
options.text: Its graph always passes through the origin.

options.label: B
options.text: Its graph always curves upward.

options.label: C
options.text: Its graph is a straight line.

options.label: D
options.text: Its graph is always a parabola.

questions.explanation: By definition, a linear function's graph is a straight line, with a constant rate of change (slope) throughout.
questions.hint: Think about the shape of the graph that gives linear functions their name.

questions.learningObjective: Determine whether a table of values represents a linear function by checking constant differences
questions.question: Does the table of values {(0, 10), (1, 9), (2, 8), (3, 7)} represent a linear function?

options.label: A
options.text: Yes, because the differences between consecutive y-values are constant.

options.label: B
options.text: Yes, because all the y-values are positive.

options.label: C
options.text: No, because the differences between consecutive y-values are not constant.

options.label: D
options.text: No, because the x-values are consecutive integers.

questions.explanation: The differences between consecutive y-values are [-1, -1, -1]. These are constant, confirming a linear relationship.
questions.hint: Check whether the differences between consecutive y-values (for equally spaced x-values) stay constant.
